activity_summary: You came in from the lane behind the three. They were already in the house. You had not yet seen the cloth opened.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came in, and took the knife out and home.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Came in last with him, and kept the afternoon a middle.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Had the house, and kept the corner until after the water.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Had carried the cloth, and brought the book.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Had raced the lane, and was not given a new rule.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Had walked, and kept a name she would not tell.

entities.name: the pie
entities.context: Mentioned in Came in from the lane

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: We are the last of us.
